Meta.title: معرض كل الطرق للسيارات | All Roads Car Showroom
Meta.description: All Roads Car Showroom — your destination for luxury cars and consignment & marketing services in the Sultanate of Oman.

Hero.title: All Roads.. Where Luxury Meets Omani Trust.
Hero.lead: With deep Omani roots, we don't park your car.. we invest in selling it. Experience the pinnacle of GCC luxury car services, from premium care to professional marketing.

About.title: A Leading Omani Establishment
About.body: "All Roads" is a leading Omani establishment specializing in the consignment, marketing, and sales of GCC luxury vehicles. We believe your car is a valuable investment, providing a dedicated team to care for and market your vehicle, reflecting the highest standards of Omani hospitality.
About.pillarBody: 100% secure and guaranteed contractual & financial procedures
About.imageAlt: Luxury GCC vehicle on the open road

Services.title: Comprehensive Care for Your Investment
Services.salesBody: We handpick the best GCC spec vehicles, ensuring a transparent and secure purchasing experience.
Services.vipBody: We do not park your car — we invest in selling it. The monthly deposit (25 OMR only) is a symbolic contribution, not parking rent, for a full-time team to care for, polish, market, protect, and clear your car so it sells at the best possible price.
Services.clearanceBody: Our team handles all ROP & insurance paperwork, and we provide flexible bank financing options.

Consign.title: Comprehensive Marketing & Consignment Package
Consign.lead: We do not park your car.. we invest in selling it.
Consign.leadNote: Submit the vehicle details; it stays hidden until the showroom publishes it. Owners cannot publish the listing themselves.
Consign.depositBody: Dear vehicle owner, the monthly deposit (25 rials only) does not represent “parking rental fees”. It is a symbolic contribution from you (less than one rial per day) to appoint a complete team of professional staff working full-time to care for your car, polish it, market it, protect it, and clear its transactions — to sell it at the best possible price in the shortest time.
Consign.depositHighlight: 25 OMR per month — less than one rial a day

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: At All Roads Car Showroom, we are committed to protecting your privacy and the personal data you share with us through this website or our Meta ads.
Privacy.collectBody: We collect info provided voluntarily via contact forms (Name, Phone, Email) solely for communication and service provision.
Privacy.usageBody: Your data is never sold or rented. It is used internally by our sales team to address your inquiries.
Privacy.metaBody: This policy complies with Meta Platforms' requirements for advertising and lead generation.

Terms.title: Terms & Conditions
Terms.intro: Welcome to All Roads website. By using this site, you agree to the following terms:
Terms.natureBody: This site is an informational portal. No financial transactions or sales are concluded online.
Terms.accuracyBody: We strive for accuracy, but hold no liability for typos. Physical contracts at the showroom are the final reference.
